display.purpose: The name and the contact headline; Archivo wdth 125, 900, uppercase, sized in viewport units. Also the BZ mark.

headline.purpose: Section titles, product names, résumé headings, mobile menu items; Archivo wdth 122, 800, sentence case.

title.purpose: Company names in role rows; the same wdth 112 semibold setting in Sodium carries product kind and stack group titles.

lead.purpose: The one-line statement under a display heading; 1.125rem rising to 1.375rem.

body.purpose: Running copy at normal width; steps 0.8125, 0.875, 0.9375, 1, 1.0625rem; measures capped in ch.

label.purpose: Button text only; Archivo wdth 112, 700, uppercase, 0.06em.

data.purpose: Martian Mono for locations, periods, stack lists, index numbers, counters and the language toggle.

readout.purpose: Doto 900 for counted numbers: product facts at 2rem, preloader counter at 3.75rem.

shadows.name: beam-glow
shadows.purpose: The only glow in the system: on the 2px reconstruction beam while it scans. Never on panels, controls or text.

gradients.name: foil
gradients.purpose: The diffraction spectrum (--foil). Slate edge, name band and globe rim only.

gradients.name: field-fallback
gradients.purpose: CSS background of the field canvas, visible when WebGL2 is unavailable.

motion.name: resolve / --ease-out-strong
motion.purpose: Strong ease-out. GSAP default ease (default duration 0.6s); CSS press, underline, icon nudge, image hover.

motion.name: travel / --ease-in-out-strong
motion.purpose: In-out for things crossing the screen: beam scans, clip-path wipes, the touch foil pass.

motion.name: duration-feedback
motion.purpose: Control feedback: 160ms button colour and press, 150ms toggles and icon buttons, 200ms nav state, lightbox fade and icon nudge.

motion.name: duration-draw
motion.purpose: Link underline draw and screenshot swap (fade from blur(3px)).

motion.name: duration-image-hover
motion.purpose: Plate and document image scale on hover (1.5% and 1%).

motion.name: beam-name
motion.purpose: Name wipe, bottom to top, with the beam; beam fades in 0.2s.

motion.name: beam-plate
motion.purpose: Project plate scan in the scroll direction; text out 0.15s, in 0.4s with 0.05s stagger.

motion.name: beam-list
motion.purpose: Role list scan; each row fades in 0.35s as the beam passes; once.

motion.name: resolve-fade
motion.purpose: Hero text and stack groups fading in place.

motion.name: decode
motion.purpose: Scramble-decode of the mono location line in the hero.

motion.name: portrait-form
motion.purpose: Points converge on the figure, then a bottom-up scan resolves it.

motion.name: field-retune
motion.purpose: Fringe field hue, source, gain and density per section or product; instant under reduced motion.

motion.name: foil-follow
motion.purpose: The foil band on the name following the pointer (--foil-x between 25% and 75%).

motion.name: foil-pass
motion.purpose: Touch devices: the band crosses the name once and rests at 41%.

motion.name: plate-tilt
motion.purpose: Active project plate turning toward a fine pointer.

motion.name: stage-snap
motion.purpose: Pinned project stage snapping one product per step.

motion.name: preloader
motion.value: 0.8s to 82, 0.3s to 100, 0.45s fade; 2.2s network cap; 5s CSS failsafe
motion.purpose: Short exposure on first load; skipped under reduced motion.

motion.name: smooth-scroll
motion.purpose: Page scroll smoothing; not started under reduced motion.

webgl.name: Fringe field
webgl.reducedMotion: clock frozen; still follows scroll, pointer and section hue
webgl.fallback: CSS radial gradient on the canvas

narrative.overview:
A holographic plate stores an object as interference fringes and gives it back when light hits it. The whole site behaves like one: the ground behind every section is a live fringe field, and each subject (the engineer in the hero, then one product at a time) is reconstructed out of it by a scanning beam. The page is dark, sparse and typographically loud; the spectacle sits in the background and in two 3D objects, while text, controls and screenshots stay flat, sharp and readable on ink.

The system is small on purpose. One ground (blue-black ink, never pure black), three named lights with fixed jobs (Holo, Flare, Sodium), one material (Foil, the diffraction spectrum) and one container (the slate). Type is one family pushed across its width axis, plus two faces reserved for measurements and numbers. Corners are square everywhere. Nothing floats: there are no cards with shadows, no rounded panels, no gradient fills on surfaces.

The world was refused as: a neon-on-black terminal portfolio with a typing headline, a card grid of projects, a skills progress-bar wall.
keyCharacteristics: Blue-black ink ground with a fixed, pointer-reactive interference-fringe shader behind all content.
Three lights with one job each: Holo (beam, focus, live state), Flare (the primary action), Sodium (secondary data).
Foil is a material, not a colour: it appears on the name, on slate edges and on the globe's rim, nowhere else.
Archivo across its width axis (125 display, 122 heading, 112 titles and labels, 100 text); Martian Mono for data; Doto for numeric readouts.
Square corners (0 radius) and 1px hairlines; the slate is the only framed container.
Things resolve (scan, wipe, decode, converge, fade in place). They do not bounce.

rules.name: The One Job Rule
rules.body: Each light has one job. Holo is state and beam, Flare is the primary action, Sodium is secondary data. A second Flare button in the same view, or Sodium on a control, breaks the code.

rules.name: The Foil Is A Material Rule
rules.body: The spectrum never fills a surface, a button or body text. It is an edge, a band crossing solid type, or a 3D film.

rules.name: The Ink Rule
rules.body: No pure black and no pure white. The ground is Void; the lightest text is Text.

rules.name: The Width Is The Voice Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is set with Archivo's `wdth` axis: 125 display, 122 heading, 112 titles and labels, 100 text. Do not add a display family; do not set running text wider than 100.

rules.name: The Instruments Rule
rules.body: Martian Mono is for data and Doto is for numbers. Neither sets a sentence, a heading or a button label.

rules.name: The Solid Letter Rule
rules.body: Foil-stamped type is solid Text crossed by a narrow band. The band is a bright first order (blue, cyan, lime, amber, red) between two faint orders mixed 30% into Text, ruled by a fine grating (`0.034em` gap, `0.014em` line, 100deg). The band never covers the word; most of the name stays plain Text at every pointer position.

rules.name: The Only The Beam Glows Rule
rules.body: Glow is reserved for the moving beam. Panels, buttons, text and icons never carry a halo or a shadow.

rules.name: The Plate Stays Ink Rule
rules.body: Surfaces above the field are opaque or near-opaque Void. No frosted cards.

dos: Do build on Void (`oklch(0.145 0.028 262)`) and let the fringe field show through; keep text blocks unboxed and ruled with 1px Line.
Do give each view exactly one Flare button, with Void text and the `0.625rem` chamfer; make every other action quiet or a text link.
Do use Holo for focus (`2px solid`, `3px` offset), hover on quiet controls and links, and anything current or live.
Do set hierarchy with Archivo's width axis: 125 / 900 uppercase for display, 122 / 800 for headings, 112 / 600 to 700 for titles and labels, 100 for text.
Do put measurements in Martian Mono at 0.75rem and counted numbers in Doto 900, with tabular figures.
Do frame screenshots and documents, and only those, in a slate: Void 2 plate, 1px Foil edge, Holo registration ticks.

Do bring content in by resolving it: a beam with a `clip-path` wipe, a fade in place, a decode. Use `resolve` (`0.23, 1, 0.32, 1`) for exits to rest and `travel` (`0.77, 0, 0.175, 1`) for crossings; keep control feedback at 150 to 200ms.

Do gate hover behind `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)`, wrap GSAP work in `gsap.matchMedia()` with the reduced-motion query, and give every enhanced layout a plain default that works without script.
Do cap canvas DPR (1.5 field, 1.75 objects), stop frame loops off screen, and keep every canvas `aria-hidden` with content that reads without it.
Do keep text at Text 3 or lighter on Void (6.4:1 is the floor) and interactive targets at 2.75rem or more.
donts: Don't use pure black or pure white, or introduce a hue outside Holo, Flare, Sodium and the neutrals for UI. The seven field hues tint the background only.
Don't use Foil as a fill, a button colour or a text gradient that covers the word. It is an edge, a narrow band, or the globe's rim.
Don't round a corner. The system has no radius; the only shaped corner is the primary button's chamfer.
Don't add shadows, halos or glow to panels, buttons, text or icons. Only the moving beam glows.
Don't build glass or frosted cards. The one backdrop blur is the scrolled nav bar.
Don't lay products out as a card grid, show skills as progress bars, or type a headline out letter by letter. These are the refused forms of this world.
Don't set sentences, headings or button labels in Martian Mono or Doto.
Don't bounce, spring or overshoot. No elastic eases.
Don't wrap text, lists or rows in a slate, or nest slates.
Don't let the pointer drive anything on touch, and don't make any content depend on WebGL having loaded.
